_about: Reader-visible text for the game. Written by the agent; listed in SECOND-ORDER.md for Sam to read. Follows TONE.md.
title: Chum and Slash
tagline: The wall has fallen. Get out of the city.
start_note: Sound and the controller start after a click.
menu.controls: Keyboard and mouse, or plug in a PlayStation or Xbox controller.
arena1.title: The park above the lake
arena1.c1: The wall fell at dawn. The Defence Force is gone, and the colony is leaving the city.
arena1.c2: Your utility tool is in your hand: axe, pick and blade. Fast things slow near the fauna, so everyone fights up close.
arena1.c3: Something bright moves between the trees.
arena2.title: The overlook
arena2.c1: A colonist lies by the path, badly hurt.
arena2.c2: "They hunt in threes. Hold the ability button and strike, and spin: it stops all of them at once."
arena2.c3: You have learned the Whirlwind Strike.
arena3.title: The lakeside steps
arena3.c1: A guard waves you down toward the water.
arena3.c2: "That big one is badly hurt and will not fight back. Light, heavy, light, light, heavy, then launch it."
arena4.title: The north gate
arena4.c1: The last carts of the colony roll toward the north gate.
arena4.c2: A pack has found the road: four dogs and a large one, all at once.
arena4.c3: Hold the gate until the carts are through.
sandbox.title: Sandbox
won.last: The prologue's four fights are done. More of the city waits.
lost: You fell. The fight starts again from the checkpoint.
hint: Press the button shown to do the move.
strip.again: The string broke. Start again with a light attack.
no_webgl: This page needs WebGL 2. Try another browser.
